verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents SDKs (Python, TypeScript) and a REST API for integrating browser automation into products, with concrete API usage like page.extract/data_extraction_schema, plus a live MCP server and CLI confirmed by probes, giving strong evidence of a documented, functional public API surface. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probes returned 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
